content.text:
**Finding: deviation (critical rule IP)** — submitted with a validated preferred-position redline.

What I found in § 4:
- **§ 4(a) (p0017)** — ownership of the "Works" only arises "to the extent that such Works were created ... over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid," and there is no assignment language at all. Title to in-progress or unpaid work product therefore remains with RadialSpark.
- **§ 4(c) (p0021)** — the licence back for Contractor's Information embedded in the Works is perpetual, royalty-free and sublicensable (good), but not irrevocable or worldwide.
- **No Customer Data provision** — our data is protected only as Confidential Information under § 8; nothing confirms Clear Capital retains ownership of its data and pre-existing IP, and there is no bar on joint ownership.
- § 4(b) (Contractor's own pre-existing tools and methodologies) is acceptable under the playbook and was left intact.

Redline: Works vest in Company on creation with an express irrevocable assignment not conditioned on payment; embedded-IP licence made worldwide and irrevocable; new § 4(e) confirming Company Data ownership, use limited to performing the Services, and no joint ownership. The comment offers the fallback of a payment-triggered assignment paired with an interim perpetual, irrevocable licence.
